rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out or C:repeated_word
notes: Polytonic folk-style verse (Krystallis, 1916, test split); most labels match, including breathings, elisions and dialect forms (lines 2-18, 23, 27, 29, 33-35). The final-sigma flag is mostly a false positive on elided forms like 'Ἔσβυσ᾽', 'μέσ᾽' (1, 38), though line 1 also misreads β as δ. The real errors are crop/label mismatches where cpp_vs_book_out fires (21: label keeps only the line's last words; 26 and 28: the label belongs to a different line from the crop) and doubled readings where repeated_word fires (30 'σκλαδιᾶς ιᾶς σου σου', 31 'λαμπρὸς λαμπρὸς'). Some truncations escape the flags (19 drops 'οἱ κάμποι'), but they are rare.
